final_game_state: GameState.WIN (frame with zero layers, levels_completed=6 on the preceding frame)
novel_mechanics_found: Three genuinely hidden mechanics discovered at runtime. (1) The floating 2-bordered sprite is a REGION SELECTOR that walks 8 anchor positions around the canvas (a 3x3 grid minus center) via ACTION1-4 (up/down/left/right, saturating at edges); each anchor holds a fixed geometric stencil: N/S/E/W = top/bottom/right/left half of the 10x10 canvas, NE={c>=r}, SW={c<=r}, SE={r+c>=9}, NW={r+c<=9}; ACTION5 floods the stencil with the selected palette color, last-writer-wins, so targets are composed as layered paint coats. (2) THE KEY HIDDEN MECHANIC: the four edge anchors (N/E/S/W) display a small notched "handle" box next to the big stencil box; CLICKING that small box (ACTION6 at its screen coords, e.g. x=32,y=21 at N or x=14,y=38 at W) stamps a SECONDARY small 4x3 (N/S) or 3x4 (W/E) rectangle at a fixed canvas position (N: rows0-2,cols3-6; W: rows3-6,cols0-2). This is undiscoverable from ACTION1-5 alone and is required from level 3 onward -- the wa30 meta-lesson (investigate unexplained glyphs) paid off exactly here. (3) Levels 3-6 targets also exploit empty(0) cells: level 6 requires LEAVING the {c<=4, r+c>=10} staircase unpainted, achieved purely by coat ordering since the canvas starts empty.
narrative: Replayed the banked 20-action L1+L2 prefix (verified levels_completed=2 in exactly 20 steps), then probed the level-3 UI: mapped ACTION1-4 as selector movement around 8 anchor stencils, ACTION5 as stencil fill, ACTION6 palette clicks as color selection (palette centers drift per level as the registry warned). Composed level 3 as SE(8) -> right-half(E) -> NW(F), leaving only a 4x3 C-rectangle that NO stencil could produce; after canvas-clicks and target-clicks proved inert, clicking the N sprite`s small handle box (with C selected) stamped exactly that rectangle and won the level. Levels 4, 5, 6 then fell in 14/18/16 actions respectively using pure stencil-composition planning plus the small-box stamps (L6 additionally required leaving a staircase region unpainted via coat order). The game reached GameState.WIN after level 6 -- cd82 is now FULLY CLEARED. A minimal 84-label sequence (20 banked + 64 new) was built and passed the offline reproduction gate from a fresh reset: reached_level=6, reproduced=True. Stopped because the game is complete.
